task_description: Integrate TMY (Typical Meteorological Year) data from PVGIS API to replace the simplified irradiance model with real meteorological data. Implement proper POA model with beam/diffuse/ground separation, shading only on beam, real temperature from TMY with NOCT model, caching, fallback to old model, API endpoint, and frontend button.

verification.summary: 323 tests pass (299 existing + 24 new). Build succeeds. Integration test validates 54N/30deg/south/1kWp produces within 900-1050 kWh/year range using real PVGIS data.
